c-964621f4daf8bba6.texto: Barley was the usual fodder for cattle. They were also fed with a mixture of chopped straw, barley, beans, and pounded date kernels.

h-ce202a5b390a9bc1.texto: De Salomón al reino dividido, hasta cerca del reinado de Ocozías de Israel. Sin introducción propia de JFB en el repositorio; Poole sí la tiene.
